description.short_caption: Dusky discoloration and swelling of both hands.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows both hands with diffuse dusky discoloration, consistent with cyanosis or ischemia. There is visible swelling and mottling of the skin, with a bluish-purple hue. The fingers appear slightly flexed, and the skin shows signs of dryness and cracking. The findings suggest compromised blood flow or severe systemic illness.
